articles.summary: MVB Financial Corp. (NASDAQ: MVBF) (“MVB” or the “Company”) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per share, consistent with the previous quarter’s dividend. The dividend is payable on December 15, 2026, for shareholders of record as of December 1, 2026. This is the fourth quarterly dividend for 2026. “During the third quarter, MVB made tangible progress on several key initiatives that are strengthening our underlying business. Net interest income increased 18% through the first nine months of the year, while core net interest margin expanded by 15 basis points during the quarter to 4.02%. An important contributor to that improvement has been the continued growth of our Fintech Payments deposit relationships. Our payments business is also generating meaningful fee income growth, with payment card and service charge income up 22% through the first nine months of the year. articles.summary: MVB Financial Corp. (NASDAQ: MVBF) (“MVB Financial,” “MVB” or the “Company”), the holding company for MVB Bank, Inc. (“MVB Bank”), today announced that it will participate in the TD Cowen Financials Fintech Conference, taking place November 17-18, 2026, at the Lotte New York Palace. Larry F. Mazza, Chief Executive Officer and President, and Michael Sumbs, Chief Financial Officer, will attend and be available for one-on-one investor meetings throughout the conference. Larry will also participate in the panel discussion “AI Adoption Technology Initiatives” on Wednesday, November 18, from 8 to 8:35 a.m. ET. About MVB Financial Corp. MVB Financial Corp. (Nasdaq: MVBF) is an innovative bank powering Fintech solutions in payments, card issuance and online gaming programs for leading Fintech companies nationwide, while providing traditional retail and commercial banking services within established markets.
